BiblicalUsage: Machleqah is the Aramaic word for a division or course, and it appears once, in Ezra 6:18, where the priests were set in their divisions and the Levites in their courses for the service of God at Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that ordered service is still service: God set the courses so that worship would go on without confusion.
